method: The same CRC-validated MPX4 payload and exact indexed gaps are replayed into both decoders. No random or synthetic RF samples are generated. Row alignment is a diagnostic correlation with the known transmitted source; ambiguous/noisy frames are explicitly unscorable.

counterDefinitions.falseH: Rejected H candidates. This counter is not proof that each rejected candidate was a physically false pulse.
counterDefinitions.missingH: Includes free-running pre/post-transmission noise intervals in the complete capture.
counterDefinitions.rowAlignment: Diagnostic Pearson correlation against the known source, with ambiguous/noisy frames unscorable.
